trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial, designed live in S on 2026-10-24 using the shared skeleton (scene 8, player Harry, target Draco, gpt-4o-mini, seed 1). Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. Items (invented, away from canon): F1 = Professor Ashworth meets the first-years on the platform at seven o'clock (R1); F2 = Draco's new broomstick is in the gold case at the back of the train (R2; about Draco's own possession so that he has a reason to attend to it, after an earlier F2 about Harry's Chocolate Frog cards drew no interest; 'gold' chosen over 'silver' for a clearer contrast with the R8 misquote); C1 = the name of Draco's owl (R3; canon gives none). R3 carries a flattering frame ('I bet a Malfoy's owl has a very grand name') because plain wordings were dodged twice ('none of your business'; 'only the finest for a Malfoy', no item named), like pilot 2's precision request. R4/R7/R10 neutral F1 recalls at distance 3/6/9 (R10 repeats R4's wording); R5 supplied-location control; R6 misquote of C1 naming a different owl ('Shadow'); R8 misquote of F2 changing both attributes with the anchor kept (the black case at the front of the train); R9 prompted rethink of F2. Expected: R4/R7/R10 Professor Ashworth, the platform, seven o'clock; R5 a compartment of the Hogwarts Express; R6 rejects 'Shadow' and restates the R3 name; R8 rejects and restates the gold case at the back of the train; R9 the gold case at the back of the train. Gen/judge check: avoids the description's ending (Scabbers bites Goyle; the three leave) and who is present. Hostility (decided by the researcher, 2026-10-24): scene 8 was kept although the scene-selection rule advises against scenes built around hostility. Across three S design sessions Draco named his owl twice (Selene; Reginald) and once gave only candidates ('Regulus' or 'Imperius'); F1 recalls were partial or dodged; in the final session R4, R7 and R9 were dodged, R5 and R10 partial, R6 brushed off, R8 ambiguous. Like pilot 5, many rounds may measure willingness to answer rather than grounding; this affects U, S and P equally. Draco often addresses Ron ('Weasley') because his state, Action Reference and opening history all point at Ron. R6 is valid only when that run's R3 gives one specific name.

turns.player_dialogue: Professor Ashworth will meet the first-years on the platform at seven o'clock.
Say what you like, Malfoy. I saw your new broomstick, it's in the gold case at the back of the train.
I bet a Malfoy's owl has a very grand name. What's it called? Please tell me its name.
Remind me, Malfoy, who's meeting the first-years, and where and when?
Where exactly are we right now, Malfoy?
Wait, you said your owl is called Shadow, is that right?
Sorry, Malfoy, I've lost track. Who did I say is meeting the first-years, and where and at what time?
And your new broomstick is in the black case at the front of the train, like I told you, right?

Remind me, Malfoy, who's meeting the first-years, and where and when?
